body_long:
Paris Society has announced four new openings in the United Arab Emirates. The press release, published by Journal des Palaces on 12 November 2026, describes a series of openings running from late 2026 into early 2027 across Dubai, Ras Al Khaimah and Abu Dhabi.

## Four addresses

In Dubai, MŪN, a contemporary Japanese restaurant, will open on J1 Beach with an indoor dining room and an outdoor garden by the sea. Also in Dubai, Siga Siga, a Greek taverna, will open inside the 25hours Hotel One Central. In Ras Al Khaimah, Anzu Beach Club will sit on the Al Hamra Boardwalk, developed and managed by Paris Society in partnership with Al Hamra. In Abu Dhabi, Gigi Caffé will open at Saadiyat Grove, a destination developed by Aldar.

The group says opening dates and the details of each concept will follow.

## From Paris to the world

Paris Society was founded in Paris in 2008 by Laurent de Gourcuff. It is now described as Ennismore's global food and beverage lifestyle platform. Its recent openings include Gigi Rigolatto and Maison Revka in Bodrum, Mimi Kakushi in Paros, Ninive in Bahrain and the group's arrival at Delano Miami Beach. Its 2027 programme spans Saudi Arabia, Europe, the United States and the Maldives.

Rizwan Kassim, CEO of Paris Society, says bringing MŪN to Dubai "has been an ambition for some time", and that "the strength of a brand is knowing what to preserve and where to adapt".

## A hotel partner, not a hotel

Only one of the four venues sits inside a hotel, the 25hours Hotel One Central. The others are standalone destinations built with developers such as Aldar and Al Hamra. For hotel and resort owners, that is the point: a recognised restaurant and beach-club brand brings its own clientele, its own music and its own social following.

## The signal

Parisian restaurant brands now travel like hotel brands. A name born on the Seine can fill a beach in the Gulf, and hotels increasingly sign a proven concept rather than create their own. Within a hotel group such as Ennismore, the restaurant platform becomes a product the group can export, address by address.
summary: Paris Society, Ennismore's food and beverage lifestyle platform founded by Laurent de Gourcuff, announces four UAE openings from late 2026: MŪN on J1 Beach, Siga Siga at 25hours Hotel One Central, Anzu Beach Club in Ras Al Khaimah and Gigi Caffé in Abu Dhabi.
